note: A tag floats if any of its components (split on - . _, lower-case) is in floating_tags, or if it has no digit and its first component is not in release_codenames; otherwise it is a version.
codenames_note: release_codenames are the Debian and Ubuntu releases in support on the as_of date, not every release ever made; a codename tag names a release, so it is allowed alone or with a variant.
